title: What to Know Before Closing Your Account
summary: Explains how to close a Rho-Bank account, including potential Early Closure Fees (vary by account tier and opening timeframe), required Notice Periods (same-day for basic; several weeks for premium business), and Pre-Closure Requirements (balance must be zero or at least the fee amount; no pending transactions; business savings linked accounts addressed).
faqs: Will I be charged an early closure fee to close my Rho-Bank account, and how do I find out?
How long is the notice period before my account closure can be processed?
What conditions must be met before Rho-Bank can close my account (balance and pending transactions)?
If there’s an early closure fee, how does it affect my account balance?
What should I do about linked accounts when closing a business savings account?
Who can I contact at Rho-Bank to discuss closing my account and confirm my specific requirements?
keywords: balance must be zero or ≥ fee amount
